thread:
harry: heads up - customers are seeing 403 Permission denied when switching to project 'acme-payments' in the console. Started ~1h after we rotated the service agent key for svc-infra.

sara: can you paste repro steps / exact error text? console screenshot or api call?

harry: repro via console and api. Console shows modal: `403 Permission denied`. curl to /v1/projects/acme-payments with svc-infra key returns:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"caller does not have permission to access project"}
```
Also saw an audit log entry around rotation.

luca: checking audit: rotation job by ops-eli at 3123456600 changed keys for svc-infra. Looks like the project role binding disappeared briefly right after the rotation event.

jamie: this rings like the rotation script swaps keys, then re-applies bindings but the apply step failed transiently -> callers get 403 until rebind completes. we've seen similar race before.

ops-eli: I ran the rotation cron. It was the zero-downtime flow but there was an error on the bind step against the RBAC service (timed out). I retried but the automated rebind didn't catch the failure. I'm running a manual rebind now.

sara: customer impact? are pipelines failing or just console view? need messaging.

harry: both. Their CI uses the SA key for push -> failing with 403. Console users can't open project pages. Customer is Acme Corp, high priority.

luca: immediate workarounds: 1) org admin can re-grant `project.viewer` to svc-infra for that project, or 2) generate a new API key for svc-infra and update the pipelines (quick but invasive). I'm doing option 1 now.

jamie: internal fix: add retry and verification to rotation flow so bindings never drop. I'll open a patch PR. For now we should run the internal RBAC resync for the affected project to ensure no stale state: `tools/rbac/resync --sa svc-infra --project acme-payments`

ops-eli: ran the resync and rebinds completed at 3123456820. Confirmed user access restored from my side.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-418. Link: https://internal/issues/INC-2026-418 (customer: Acme Corp). Notifying account team.

harry: verified with customer — console and pipelines working again. Thanks all. Please add postmortem notes about rotation safeguards. :thumbsup:

sara: creating a short customer-facing note and internal postmortem checklist now.

jamie: tracking action items: (1) patch rotation job, (2) add automated post-rotation verification job, (3) run backfill resync to scan for other SAs rotated in last 24h.

harry: closing the thread once docs and PMs are filed.
